events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, rap icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer whose guitar playing changed music forever. What's the Hendrix track that still blows you away?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, a masterpiece recorded at EMI Studios.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' still sounds as fresh today as it did in '69.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Pretenders Powerhouse
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the inimitable Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' is a message that still resonates today. What does John Lennon's masterpiece mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? It changed everything. How many songs did your first one hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic 007 film franchise and its enduring legacy.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the indelible mark John Lennon left on music and the world. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your favourite track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. A voice, a showman, a legend. His music continues to rock generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: A pivotal album that saw The Beatles push new boundaries. 'Rubber Soul' is 61 years old today – what's your top track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the life and legacy of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: A Voice For Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost him, John Lennon's message of peace, love, and understanding is as powerful as ever. Remembering a true legend today.
